# scm_dlp_alert_settings (Data Source)

Retrieves Enterprise DLP alert settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the tenant's DLP alert settings.
data "scm_dlp_alert_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `detection_exemption_period_minutes` (Number) Alert detection exemption period in minutes.
- `id` (String) Alert settings identifier.
- `incident_notification_enablement` (Boolean) Enable incident notifications.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.
